name: Chromium KasmVNC
postCreateCommand:
set -e; cd /tmp && curl -fsSLO https://github.com/kasmtech/KasmVNC/releases/download/v1.5.2/kasmvncserver_debian_bookworm_1.5.2_amd64.deb && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ./kasmvncserver_debian_bookworm_1.5.2_amd64.deb openbox xterm chromium fonts-liberation ffmpeg x11-xserver-utils && sudo adduser $USER ssl-cert && mkdir -p ~/.vnc && printf 'desktop:
  resolution:
    width: 1280
    height: 720
  allow_resize: true
network:
  protocol: http
  interface: 0.0.0.0
  websocket_port: 6901
  ssl:
    require_ssl: false
' > ~/.vnc/kasmvnc.yaml && printf '#!/bin/sh
chromium --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu --start-maximized &
exec openbox-session
' > ~/.vnc/xstartup && chmod +x ~/.vnc/xstartup && printf 'vscode
vscode
' | vncpasswd -u vscode -w -r
